name: Composite Loss for Radiance Fields
aliases: Optimizing Radiance Fields for Few-Shot Novel-View Synthesis
definition: The optimization process decodes color and density for backgrounds using dedicated near and far background MLPs, rendering volumetrically, and enforcing a composite loss.
summary: Composite Loss optimizes radiance fields for few-shot synthesis by combining L2, distortion, and LPIPS losses to enforce background MLP sparsity, distinguishing it from standard alpha-compositing.
